verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented OneDrive feature for exporting all of a user's data in open formats or for migrating away. The Microsoft Graph file APIs are developer building blocks, and 'Always keep on this device' is an offline-sync control, not an export capability, so neither earns credit. Community comments about trust and sync problems do not address data export and were set aside.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
